builder_wallet_holds_fees_occurred.meaning: BuilderWallet holds accumulated builder fees routed to it during settlement

builder_admin_overwritten.meaning: builderAdmin storage slot was overwritten by a permissionless init call

fees_drained.meaning: the wallet's full accumulated builder-fee token balance was transferred out to the attacker

claims.scope: BuilderWallet fee-recipient initialization and sweep of accumulated builder fees

preconditions.text: BuilderWallet is the fee recipient for builder split commissions and can hold accumulated builder fees (shares/tokens) routed to it during settlement.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Inferred: builderAdmin should only be set through a guarded, one-time initialization so that only the legitimate authority can become builderAdmin and sweep the wallet's fees.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The wallet's full token balance of accumulated builder fees is transferred to the attacker, causing direct loss of funds intended for builders.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: BuilderWallet is used as feeRecipient for builder split commissions and receives shares/tokens during CollateralTracker settlement.
The attacker is an unauthorized caller, not the legitimate builderAdmin authority.
Whether init had already been called by a legitimate admin before the attack is not established by the report.

limitations: Only the fees_drained impact is formalized; builder_admin_overwritten is used as a condition observable, not as a separately covered impact.
The plan does not assert that fees were present or that an incident occurred; it encodes the report's stated capability under the holding precondition.
Authorization is represented by the report-grounded overwrite occurrence plus the absence of the drain; the exact guard implementation is deferred to code binding.
No numeric amounts or concrete addresses are bound; symbolic observables are used.
